purpose: Positive reference for detecting a meaningful long-lived descending structural resistance trendline independently from complete pattern detection
desired_behavior: Anchor the trendline at a meaningful structural high
Reward long-lived trendlines that continue to explain subsequent price action
Use repeated price interaction as evidence of structural significance
Allow a valuable structural trendline to exist even when no high-quality wedge or triangle can be constructed from it
notes: This reference separates trendline quality from complete pattern quality. The descending upper boundary is useful even if the corresponding 5m wedge has weak convergence.
